exceptions.justification: Accepted by the maintainer for Hospital 1.9.0 on 2026-11-14 (as for 1.8.0 to 1.8.3): an unfixed finding. go-jose/v3 3.0.5 is the latest v3 release and has no fix; it is required by smallstep/certificates 0.30.2 (latest), which Caddy 2.11.7 to 2.11.9 use for its internal PKI (tls internal). The vulnerable path parses attacker-supplied JWKs, which only an ACME server does, and the appliance runs none. go-jose/v4 is already at 4.1.6. Accepted until upstream removes or patches v3.
